    // The budget application table this rule cares about - must match the Script Include
    var TABLE_NAME = 'x_1962601_budget_t_budget';

    // sys_attachment fires for EVERY attachment in the instance, so exit fast if it is not ours
    if (current.getValue('table_name') !== TABLE_NAME)
        return;

    // Read the file name and lower-case it so extension checking is case-insensitive
    var fileName = ('' + current.getValue('file_name')).toLowerCase();

    // Ignore anything that is not an Excel workbook, e.g. a PDF quote or a screenshot
    if (fileName.slice(-5) !== '.xlsx')
        return;

    // Wrap the call so a bad file never blocks the user's upload with a stack trace
    try {
        // Run the calculation against the record the attachment belongs to
        new BudgetSpreadsheetTotal().recalculate(current.getValue('table_sys_id'));
    } catch (ex) {
        // Record the failure in the system log for an admin to investigate
        gs.error('Budget total recalculation failed for attachment ' + current.getUniqueValue() + ': ' + ex);
    }

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-05 11:18:25</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>3b613e0dc3a28b50e5c2160ed401312b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Recalculate budget total on spreadsheet2</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Budget Track" source="x_1962601_budget_t">53dba074c373321084365205e40131e9</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Budget Track">53dba074c373321084365205e40131e9</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_3b613e0dc3a28b50e5c2160ed401312b</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-05 21:58:28</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=3b613e0dc3a28b50e5c2160ed401312b"/></record_update>
